guide.title: How it works
guide.intro: SogaeBank is where you make referrals and earn referral fees. Individual members can do everything once they sign up and verify their identity; only businesses that need a license to register (real estate agents, insurance, medical, etc.) register after getting that verification.

s1.d: Individuals verify their identity, businesses verify with their business registration number, and an operator approves. Before approval you can only browse.

s2.d: List what you can refer, or post what you need as a request.

s3.d: An operator checks it. Restricted businesses cannot be listed.

s4.d: When a chat starts, a referral code is issued and attribution begins.

s5.d: A deal is closed only when both sides confirm.

s6.d: The full referral fee goes to the referrer — the platform takes nothing.

guide.note: Click a document name to open its full text. The published version is shown as is — with its effective date and version number.

agree.title: Agree to terms
agree.allDone: You have agreed to all required terms.
agree.neededBody: You need to agree to the required terms to use features that require login. Browsing, viewing terms and logging out still work. Optional items (marketing · personalized ads · night-time ads) stay as they are.
agree.okTitle: You have agreed to all required terms
agree.okBody: You have agreed to the current versions. If the terms change, the changes will appear here and we will ask for your consent again.
agree.none: No terms have been published yet. We do not collect consent before publishing — if you agreed to a draft, you could not later confirm what you agreed to once the text changed.
agree.logged: The time of consent is recorded. If a dispute arises later over “I never agreed”, this record serves as evidence.
agree.optAnytime: You can change optional items at any time. Marketing messages and interest-based ads are not required, and withdrawing does not affect your use of the service.

form.reqHint: You cannot use the service without agreeing.
form.optHint: Not agreeing does not affect your use of the service.
form.needAll: You must agree to all required items to continue.

opt.toReject: “{title}” changed to declined. The change is recorded.
opt.toAgree: “{title}” changed to agreed. The change is recorded.
opt.hint: Each change adds a new record (never deleted or edited), and ads and notifications follow the most recent record. Required terms cannot be turned off here (only by leaving the service).
